# Contributing to 11.11.11

Thank you for your interest in contributing! We welcome all contributions, bug reports, and suggestions.

## Code of Conduct

All contributors and participants are expected to adhere to our [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## How Can I Contribute?

### Reporting Bugs
- Check existing [issues](https://github.com/Academypeep/11.11.11/issues) to avoid duplicates.
- Use our [Bug Report Template](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml) and include detailed steps to reproduce.

### Suggesting Enhancements
- Open a feature request via our [Feature Request Template](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml).
- Explain why this enhancement would be useful and outline potential implementations.

### Pull Requests
1. Fork the repo and create your branch from `main`:
   ```bash
   git checkout -b feat/my-new-feature
   ```
2. Follow Conventional Commits:
   - `feat:` for new features
   - `fix:` for bug fixes
   - `docs:` for documentation updates
   - `chore:` for tooling or configuration changes
3. Ensure all tests and lint checks pass locally before opening a pull request.
4. Push your changes and open a Pull Request using our PR template.

## Review Process
- All submissions require review and CI verification before merging.
- Address any requested changes promptly.
